subject: Pilot accelerator pro-bono grant — packaging & success metrics
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <sophie@bluegate.org>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: pro-bono pilot credits for BlueGate cohort (6 startups)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for chatting yesterday. BlueGate is launching an autumn micro-cohort (6 early teams) focused on product integrations and we'd love to partner with Redwood on a pro-bono pilot to accelerate model-led prototypes. High-level ask:

- Grant: platform credits to cover ~3 months of usage for 6 startups (we estimate ~$60k total, flexible if you prefer a different structuring).
- Packaging: ideally one program-level allocation made available to startups (not separate enterprise invoices) — we can handle eligibility and onboarding.
- Metrics: we're happy to run a small success evaluation (engagement + prototype demos) and share outcomes.

We can be flexible on accounting — a single PO from BlueGate or a program credit applied by Redwood works for us. I'm attaching a one-page MAP with timelines and success metrics so you can see our ask in context.

Are you able to waive the usual minimums for this program and license credits at the program level? If so we'd love to put dates in place and get a quick kickoff call this week.

Best,
Sophie Lane
Program Director, BlueGate Accelerator
Sophie Lane
BlueGate Accelerator

--Attachment: pilot-MAP-v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie@bluegate.org>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pro-bono pilot credits for BlueGate cohort (6 startups)

Hey Sophie — thanks for the clear MAP (looks reasonable). We're excited to support BlueGate. A few pragmatic options from Redwood so we can move quickly:

Option A — Program Grant (fastest delivery)
- Redwood issues a single program allocation: $60,000 in platform credits assigned to BlueGate account.
- We create 6 sub-allocations ($10k each) you can distribute to startups.
- Valid for 90 days from activation; unused credits expire.
- No individual invoicing unless a startup exceeds their allocation (then we invoice that startup or BlueGate per your preference).

Option B — Structured Pilot (success conditional)
- $30k in credits upfront + $30k unlocked if cohort meets the MAP success metrics (demo + active usage thresholds).
- Requires a short success report at day 75 to trigger the second tranche.

Operational asks from our side:
- Finance needs a PO or signed confirmation of who owns the program account for invoicing and tax treatment.
- Legal prefers a simple addendum to our standard T&Cs for program-level grants (we can provide a one-page addendum).

I'm looping in Ben (partnerships) and Neha (finance) to confirm feasibility and any billing constraints. If any of these feel off, Ben/Neha will propose tweaks.

If you're good with Option A or B we can provision a sandbox org this week and get the onboarding docs out. Call? I'm free tomorrow 10–11am PT.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

--Attachment: usage-forecast-bluegate.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pro-bono pilot credits for BlueGate cohort (6 startups)

Marissa — quick flags from my side:

- Lean toward Option A for speed but tighten per-startup caps to $10k max and a daily rate cap to avoid long-running jobs consuming credits quickly.
- Recommend adding a 30-day roll-over buffer (unused credits can be used for another BlueGate cohort within 30 days) — helps with onboarding slippage.
- Finance (Neha) will need a single PO with program-level billing entity and a short statement of work. If BlueGate wants us to invoice startups directly when they breach caps, we need their billing contacts upfront.
- From a conversion playbook: propose a 3–6 month follow-on discount (25–50% off first paid month) if startups convert to paid accounts — helps measure program ROI.

If BlueGate signs off we can create the program account, push credits, and send a one-page addendum for signature.

Ben
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

(Neha) can you confirm if a single PO plus addendum is sufficient for accounting and tax?

From: Sophie Lane <sophie@bluegate.org>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@bluegate.org
Date: 2026-10-22T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot accelerator pro-bono grant — packaging & success metrics

Marissa / Ben / Neha —

Thank you — Option A with Ben's tweaks sounds good to BlueGate. We accept:

- Program allocation: $60,000 platform credits, split into six $10k sub-allocations.
- 90-day validity from activation + 30-day roll-over window.
- BlueGate will provide a single PO for the program billing entity (see attached PO stub sent to ops@redwood.ai).
- We agree to provide a short success report at day 75.
- We'd like the conversion incentive clause you mentioned (please propose language).

Next steps:
1) Marissa/Ben: send the one-page addendum and a DocuSign link for the PO/addendum.
2) Once signed, provision the program org and sub-allocations; share onboarding checklist with the cohort.
3) BlueGate will share billing contacts for each startup only if/when they exceed allocation.

Sophie Lane
Program Director, BlueGate Accelerator
BlueGate Accelerator
